items.title: Quick hits: American dream comes crashing down, Mbappé hits back at abuse
items.description: The US goes crashing out of its own World Cup after days of controversy and rancour, while Kylian Mbappé refuses to stand for dreadful racist abuse. Here are today's quick hits.

items.title: China has sent the world a reminder of its growing military power
items.description: This latest military test demonstrates China's growing willingness to use its military strength to send a warning to the Pacific: that Beijing now has the military and nuclear means to assert its dominance in the region.

items.title: Breaking: Foxtel boss says Kayo 'very well priced' as $5.3b NRL rights deal revealed
items.description: The NRL reveals its new broadcast rights deal worth billions of dollars over seven years from the end of the 2027 season.

items.title: AFL legend Tony Modra 'overwhelmed by the kindness' after truck crash
items.description: Adelaide Crows legend Tony Modra says he has left hospital after he was seriously injured in a truck crash last month.

items.title: TikTok says 98pc of harmful content removed before being seen in Australia
items.description: Most of the harmful content uploaded to TikTok is automatically removed before it can be seen by Australian social media users, the Royal Commission on Antisemitism and Social Cohesion hears.

items.title: Richard White resigns as WiseTech chair but will remain with firm
items.description: The billionaire founder of WiseTech Global said he was stepping down as the company's chair after "recent personal media attention" created an "unnecessary distraction" from the business.

items.title: Microsoft workers in Australia to be caught up in 4,800 global job cuts
items.description: ABC News understands Microsoft Australia staff will be impacted by the tech giant's latest round of lay-offs. Microsoft will cut about 2.1 per cent of its global workforce.

items.title: After months of Trump threats, Cuba says he's committing 'genocide'
items.description: The lives of ordinary Cubans have ground to a halt under an economic and humanitarian crisis that has developed over years and been aggravated by US President Donald Trump's harsh restrictions, experts say.

items.title: Live: Nine shares up as it retains NRL free-to-air rights for $145m a year
items.description: Nine Entertainment retains the free-to-air rights to the National Rugby League through to 2034. Shares in WiseTech global are surging in early trade.  Follow the day's events and insights from our business reporters on the ABC News live markets blog.

items.title: Pam the Bird graffiti vandal detained after bridge standoff
items.description: A trespasser has been detained by police after spending many hours at the top of a 140- metre-high tower of the Bolte Bridge in Melbourne where he'd spray-painted the surface with the notorious graffiti symbol.

items.title: President Trump Announces U.S. Military Airstrike in Venezuela
items.description: President Trump states the U.S. military conducted its first known airstrike inside Venezuela targeting a dock where drugs were allegedly loaded onto boats[1][2][4].

items.title: Trump Meets Netanyahu at Mar-a-Lago for Gaza Ceasefire Phase Two Talks
items.description: President Trump met with Israeli Prime Minister Netanyahu to discuss advancing phase two of the Gaza ceasefire, including reconstruction and responses to Iran[1][4].

items.title: Feds Launch Massive Taxpayer Fraud Probe in Minnesota After Viral Video
items.description: Federal agencies including DHS, FBI, and ICE investigate $110 million in suspected fraud at Minnesota child care centers following a viral YouTube video[3].

items.title: Americans Express Widespread Opposition to AI Data Centers
items.description: Public backlash against AI infrastructure data centers grows, with protests and demands for bans influencing Democratic Party strategies for future elections[3].

items.title: Elon Musk's Humanoid Robot Vision: China Poised to Lead Production
items.description: China prioritizes humanoid robots in tech race with U.S., ramping up production while warning of industry bubble and potential bottlenecks[3].

items.title: Trump-Putin Call Amid Ukraine-Russia Tensions Over Peace Plan
items.description: President Trump spoke with Putin amid ongoing Ukraine conflict, with Russia reevaluating peace plan tenets after Ukrainian denials[1].

items.title: Democratic Gubernatorial Candidates in Wisconsin Focus on Inflation and Trump
items.description: Seven Democrats vying for Wisconsin governor blame economic issues on Trump and emphasize affordability ahead of 2026 primary[3].
